Negatives on record: (1) zero live receipts carry a dated stamp line today (only MICKEY17 matched even the OLD prefilter), so the admit path has no estate coverage and its proof is fixture-based; the gate is currently guarding an empty set. (3) The ratchet's own PASS line and the CONFIG-SEAL FAIL line contain em-dashes as tool output; both are rendered [em-dash] in the filed evidence per the t51 convention, none authored.
